{"id":1861397935,"question_id":4138,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months","timestamp":1766307086,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1861397935/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Deletion Cost to Make All Characters Equal","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using pi = pair<long long,char>;\n\n    long long minCost(string s, vector<int>& cost) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        unordered_map<char,long long>mp;\n        priority_queue<pi , vector<pi> , greater<pi>>pq;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            pq.push({cost[i] , s[i]});\n            mp[s[i]]++;\n        }\n        if(mp.size() == 1) return 0;\n        \n        long long totalcost = 0;\n        while(pq.size() != 1 and mp.size() != 1)\n        {\n            auto[cost , ch] = pq.top(); pq.pop();\n            totalcost += cost;\n            mp[ch]--;\n            if(mp[ch] == 0) mp.erase(ch);\n        }\n        return totalcost;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-deletion-cost-to-make-all-characters-equal","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1363}
